definitions.explanation: The real amount spent, without markup or profit. The cost at which something was actually purchased or produced.

examples.japanese: {交通費|こうつうひ}は{実費|じっぴ}で{支給|しきゅう}します。
examples.english: Transportation costs will be reimbursed at actual cost.

examples.japanese: {材料|ざいりょう}は{実費|じっぴ}でお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please pay the actual cost for materials.

examples.japanese: ボランティアなので{報酬|ほうしゅう}はないが、{実費|じっぴ}だけは{負担|ふたん}してもらえる。
examples.english: Since it's volunteer work there's no pay, but actual expenses are covered.

notes:
Often used in business and organizational contexts to distinguish actual costs from estimated or marked-up prices.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{実費|じっぴ}で (at actual cost)
・{実費|じっぴ}{精算|せいさん} (settlement at actual cost)
・{実費|じっぴ}{負担|ふたん} (bearing actual expenses)
